name: an intent over PUSH_MAX_BYTES is not enqueued: the commit answers too-large and writes one notice and no clock (limits shrink PUSH_MAX_BYTES)
a create beyond a cap is refused at commit: cap, with nothing written, no notice and no tick
a held delete still occupies its slot: a create while it waits is refused cap
once the delete is released and acked its slot is free: the create fits
a gesture creating one card and deleting another at the cap passes the growth rule
a plain gesture over two records is two intents with one stamp and one gesture id
an atomic gesture is one intent
a held gesture is one held intent released HOLD_MS after the device time
a command is one intent carrying its prediction on the entry
a command with deltas is one intent
a signed-out replica commits under lineage anon
device rows commit with the gesture, a localOnly picture among them
a commit with only device rows enqueues nothing; null deletes a row
a board death pulled from the product scope makes its tree and overlay known gone: commits refuse scope-dead and write nothing
a board delete still held leaves its tree writable
an overlay of a tree known not-found refuses scope-dead
a released board delete makes its tree refuse scope-dead
